pythonFunction.name: send_sms_account_number
pythonFunction.description:
Sends the full account number by text message to the mobile number on file. It is never spoken
or shown in chat. Needs an authenticated caller. Before calling this tool, speak a brief
conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Leave empty: the identified account is used automatically (any other id is refused).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok and sent_to_last4 (last 4 digits of the mobile number).
